method.coach.AL-1: Which priority does this move forward? If it stands alone, say why.
method.coach.AL-5: Unconfirmed is a risk. Get the confirmation, escalate, or name a risk owner.
method.coach.blocker.overdue: This blocker has not moved. Raising it with the coordinator.
method.coach.checkin.stale: This goal is stale. It cannot quietly stay green.
method.coach.confidence.critical: What changed? Name the next action.
method.coach.CY-5: A list that accommodates everything is a to-do list, not a strategy.
method.coach.CY-6: What did you stop doing to make room?
method.coach.kpi.unhealthy: This KPI is unhealthy. Fix it now, add a key result, or launch the drafted recovery OKR.
method.coach.KR-2: Where are you today? If you do not know, establishing it can be its own key result.
method.coach.KR-4: You will only find out at the end. Add a leading indicator you can act on weekly.
method.coach.KR-5: More calls, to what end? If you can measure that impact, make it the key result.
method.coach.KR-6: If this must be delivered, mark it committed. If it is a stretch, raise the targets.
method.coach.OBJ-1: If we do it and nothing changes, did we succeed?
method.coach.OBJ-2: Metrics usually belong in the key results.
method.coach.OBJ-5: If everything is a priority, nothing can be chosen. Which two would you drop?
method.coach.quality.committed_floor: A commitment nobody believes in is a risk. Escalate now, or make it aspirational.
method.coach.quality.conflict: These two claim the same movement. Check which one owns it.
method.coach.quality.divergence: Reported on track, but this key result has not moved within the divergence window.
method.coach.quality.sandbagging_close: Targets were too safe. Address stretch explicitly when drafting the next cycle.
method.coach.quality.trending_off: On current trajectory this misses. Better to say it now than at the close.
